scenes.text: Did you know the massive, barren Sahara Desert you see today was once a lush, green paradise filled with deep lakes, flowing rivers, and wild hippos?

It sounds completely unbelievable, but every twenty-one thousand years, Earth’s orbit undergoes a tiny wobble that shifts global monsoons, dragging torrential rains directly over these scorching sands and transforming the entire region into a vibrant grassland.
Archeologists have even found stunning ancient cave paintings hidden deep in the dunes depicting people swimming in deep waters that are now completely dry, proving this green oasis existed.

Scientists say this dramatic green cycle is scheduled to happen again, so would you live in a green Sahara, or do you prefer the empty dunes? Tell me what you think in the comments and follow for more!
